name: tpl-chain-response-1-goal
task: Carry the box to the exit. Whenever the box falls, pick it up again on your very next move.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(at_exit) and Response(at_exit, holding_box) together require the box to be in hands on the exit step, which is the task's carry-to-exit requirement. ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box) encodes the very-next-move pickup after a fall. All three are hard because the task has no preference cue, and no clause is redundant or added.

texts: The agent must reach the exit at some point before the episode ends.
The box must be carried to the exit: whenever the agent reaches the exit, it must be holding the box at that step or later.
Whenever the box falls, the agent must pick it up again on its very next step.
